summary: アメリカのトランプ大統領とイスラエルのネタニヤフ首相が、ホワイトハウスで会談しました。両首脳が直接会談するのは、イランへの軍事作戦の開始以降初めてで、イスラエルのメディアは両首脳がイランの核武装を阻止する決意を改めて確認したと伝えています。

title: Climate alarm ‘blaring from every direction’
summary: Climate-driven disasters are reaching “nightmare proportions” due to humanity’s “addiction” to fossil fuels, a top UN official warned on Tuesday.

title: HIV, hepatitis, STI gains at risk as funding falls, WHO warns
summary: Years of progress in tackling HIV, viral hepatitis and sexually transmitted infections (STIs) are at risk of stalling, leaving millions of people without access to life-saving prevention, testing and treatment, the World Health Organization (WHO) has warned.

title: A hijab inspection, a slap, a warning letter: Inside three months of Taliban rule
summary: A woman is stopped for buying groceries alone. The shopkeeper who served her is slapped and hauled in for questioning. A teacher is turned away from her own classroom for wearing the wrong cloak.

title: Forced online scams: IOM warns trafficking networks are booming
summary: A job advert can hide a criminal network, and a single click can lead to a nightmare. Hundreds of thousands of people are trafficked every year on the promise of legitimate work abroad, only to be held captive and forced into online scam operations.

title: Security Council LIVE: Updates on Gaza, West Bank amid regional tensions
summary: Regional tensions are mounting as the US-Iran war continues and a rising number of Israeli attacks are threatening Gaza’s fragile October ceasefire that ended two years of war with Hamas.
